department_membership_confirmed_check.name: department_membership_confirmed_check
department_membership_confirmed_check.value: ("department_membership"."state" = 'CONFIRMED') = ("department_membership"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "department_membership"."confirmed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

member_full_name_check.name: member_full_name_check
member_full_name_check.value: "member"."full_name" IS NULL OR length(btrim("member"."full_name")) BETWEEN 2 AND 120

member_redacted_check.name: member_redacted_check
member_redacted_check.value: ("member"."personal_data_redacted_at" IS NULL AND "member"."full_name" IS NOT NULL) OR ("member"."personal_data_redacted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "member"."full_name" IS NULL AND "member"."phone_e164" IS NULL)

registration_revision_complete_check.name: registration_revision_complete_check
registration_revision_complete_check.value:
"registration_revision"."redacted_at" IS NOT NULL OR
         ("registration_revision"."full_name" IS NOT NULL AND ("registration_revision"."hbc_id" IS NOT NULL OR "registration_revision"."is_new_member")
          AND ("registration_revision"."phone_e164" IS NOT NULL OR "registration_revision"."no_personal_phone")
          AND ("registration_revision"."fwo_number" IS NOT NULL OR "registration_revision"."is_new_member"))

phone_challenge_consumed_check.name: phone_challenge_consumed_check
phone_challenge_consumed_check.value: "phone_challenge"."consumed_at" IS NULL OR "phone_challenge"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL

verification_evidence_phone_check.name: verification_evidence_phone_check
verification_evidence_phone_check.value: "verification_evidence"."kind" <> 'PHONE_OTP' OR "verification_evidence"."phone_e164" IS NOT NULL OR "verification_evidence"."redacted_at" IS NOT NULL
